verdict.rationale: The README documents that any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works, including vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and cloud APIs. A setup step ('Give Me a Brain') takes your endpoint and key, storing the key in the Keychain. The app also lists the endpoint's models, accepts a manual model ID, and supports separate planner and actor models. Missing for 10: support for non-OpenAI-compatible endpoint protocols ('or otherwise'), and independent or hands-on confirmation that custom endpoints work as described.
